title: Survival Challenge Plugin
description: Survive 100 days with epic challenges, rewards, sounds, and on-screen pop-ups. Every 10 days brings new goals, gifts, and surprises in this dynamic survival adventure plugin.
body:
🏹 Overview

Survival Challenge Plugin transforms your ordinary survival world into a thrilling 100-day journey of challenges, rewards, and progression!
Every 10 days, a new task appears with an on-screen popup, sound effect, and chat message — pushing you to explore, fight, and gather to survive in your own hardcore story.

Complete each challenge to earn powerful rewards, from simple food and resources to rare blocks and end-game gear.
Can you survive 100 days and unlock the End Portal Frame to face the dragon?

⚙️ Main Features

🕒 Day Counter System — Tracks your survival days automatically.

🎯 Timed Challenges — Every 10 days a new, unique task appears.

🎁 Reward System — Get fitting rewards for completing each challenge.

🔊 Dynamic Notifications — Pop-ups, chat messages, and satisfying sounds for every event.

💬 Custom Announcements — Use /announce <message> to display pop-up messages with sound effects.

🎉 First Join Bonus — New players are greeted with a warm welcome and starter kit.

💡 Perfect For

Hardcore & 100-day survival series

Custom survival servers

Adventure / YouTube worlds

⚒️ Requirements

Paper / Spigot 1.21.5 or newer

Java 21 (Adoptium Temurin recommended)

💬 Author

👤 Developed by: Shregoo
